comparison.objective: Candidate adjusts gripper travel; this record removes a drawer from telescoping slides.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses precision coaxial tools; the record operates two opposite-sense release levers while pulling and supporting the drawer off its rails.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks a locked 90° stop through cycles; the record checks both slide releases, complete drawer removal or placement, hand clearance, and stability.
comparison.reason: Opposed latch actuation during extraction tests coordinated release and support, not mechanical calibration or locking.
